author: Symbiotic_Mutant
body: To track points and point-streaks easier as well as experience points and levels, perhaps additions to the GUI could allow that. This feature need not be limited to the nexus mini-game, however it best fits in this particular one.

title: [Nexus] Suggestion

replies.author: WaveConquerer
replies.body:
You should elaborate more on exactly what you're suggesting and how it should be carried out.  I read it twice just to understand what you're getting at.  Tell me if I understand what you'd like: a scoreboard, similar to that of the current one of the side of the screen, displaying your personal kills and current streak within your current map.

I'm not exactly sold on doing this as it may clog the screen up and blind you on either side.
